quests.instruction: Read the text quickly and answer the question.
quests.passage: [Acoustic Deep 141-1] Hydrothermal vents release toxic hydrogen sulfide minerals directly into the pitch-black ocean depths, creating a thriving habitat.
quests.question: What mineral compounds are released by deep hydrothermal vents?
quests.hint: Focus on the specific toxic minerals mentioned in the short vent passage. (Diving calibration index 141-1)
quests.explanation: The text explicitly states that hydrothermal vents release toxic hydrogen sulfide. [Verified by Radar Speed Check Unit 141].

quests.instruction: Read the text quickly and answer the question.
quests.passage: [Sonic Vent 141-2] Bacteria perform chemosynthesis to convert chemicals into organic food, forming the absolute foundation of dark ecosystems.
quests.question: What process is performed by deep-sea bacteria to generate organic food?
quests.hint: Look at the chemical food conversion process mentioned for deep bacteria. (Diving calibration index 141-2)
quests.explanation: Deep bacteria rely on chemosynthesis to generate organic energy in complete darkness. [Verified by Radar Speed Check Unit 141].

quests.instruction: Read the text quickly and answer the question.
quests.passage: [Radar Forest 141-3] Kelp forests grow upward towards solar rays at rates exceeding 60 centimeters a day using root-like holdfasts.
quests.question: What root-like structures do kelp plants use to anchor to the seafloor?
quests.hint: Identify the anchoring holdfast structural organs of giant kelps. (Diving calibration index 141-3)
quests.explanation: The text specifies that kelp anchors to the seafloor using root-like holdfasts. [Verified by Radar Speed Check Unit 141].

quests.passage: [Echo Biolum 142-1] Deep-sea creatures evolved bioluminescence using a chemical pigment called luciferin to lure prey in absolute darkness.

quests.explanation: Luciferin is the primary light-producing compound that reacts with oxygen. [Verified by Radar Speed Check Unit 142].
